projects.title: Apex Financial
projects.summary: Sub-millisecond market monitoring terminal with WebSockets and custom WebGL charting.

caseStudy.problem: Financial analysts needed instant order-book visual feedback without UI thread locks during heavy trading volatility.
caseStudy.solution: Engineered offscreen canvas worker rendering paired with binary WebSocket streaming buffers.
caseStudy.outcome: Achieved 60fps frame rates under 100k events/sec with zero jank.
